description: This plugin helps users discover, compare, and purchase international eSIM data plans for travel. Users can browse available destinations, select a data package, complete their purchase, and receive activation details for their eSIM. The plugin provides information about pricing, coverage, validity, and data allowances to help travelers stay connected while abroad.

defaultPrompt: Find the best eSIM packages for my upcoming trip.
Help me choose and purchase an eSIM for my destination.
Show my eSIMs, orders, and remaining data usage.
